help.intro: A return is a buyer's request to send delivered goods back, and the decision on it. The goods travel on a return shipment and the money moves on an invoice reversal - the return is what ties the two together.
help.step_1_body: Buyers ask from their order page, within the return window after the last delivery, naming the items and why. You can also raise one here for a client - the window does not apply in the back office. Each item is capped by what was delivered and is not already coming back.
help.step_2_body: Approving creates the return shipment: by default the goods are collected at the address they were delivered to and go back to the warehouse they left from, free to the buyer. State a price to charge for it, or a pickup address when the order was collected in person. Rejecting closes the request - write the reason in the response, the buyer sees it.
help.step_3_body: Open the return shipment and set each line's condition once the goods are inspected - resellable or damaged - and correct the quantity to what actually arrived. Moving the shipment to delivered puts resellable goods back into stock and writes damaged ones off; it is refused while a line has no condition.
help.step_4_body: As the shipment arrives the return moves to received and a draft reversal of the order's invoice is raised for the goods that came back. Review it in Invoices and issue it - issuing is what refunds what the buyer paid. Draft refund raises it again if nothing could be reversed at the time.
help.step_5_body: Close the return once the refund is settled. A return can be canceled until its goods are on the way back; canceling an approved one also withdraws its shipment.
help.note: A return that was approved has moved goods and money, so it cannot be deleted. Search takes the return number or the full reference, e.g. RMA-7.

text.pick_order_first: Pick the order first - its delivered items are offered here.
text.nothing_returnable: Nothing on this order can be returned - no delivery has arrived, or every item is already coming back.
text.lines_hint: Enter how many of each item come back. Items left at zero are not part of the return.
text.lines_requested_hint: What the buyer asked to return. What actually arrived, and in what condition, is on the return shipment.
text.decided_locked: This return has been decided - only the messages and the internal notes can still change.
text.placeholder_pickup: The address the delivery went to
text.approve_hint: Approving creates the return shipment. Leave a field empty to use the default: the warehouse the goods left from, the delivery address, and no charge to the buyer.
text.reject_effect: Refuses the request. Nothing moves; the response tells the buyer why.
text.cancel_effect: Withdraws the request. Nothing has moved, so nothing is reversed.
text.cancel_approved_effect: Withdraws the return and its shipment. Refused once the goods are on their way back.
text.close_effect: Marks the return settled - issue its refund draft first.
text.no_shipment: No return shipment yet - it is created when the return is approved.
